evals.prompt: 帮我给这篇论文做个卡片，文件在 ~/docs/papers/iclr2020-geom-gcn-pei/
evals.expected_output: Generate both card.md (quick) and card-deep.md (deep) from the acquired paper.
expectations: The skill detects input as folder_slug (metadata.yaml exists under $PAPERS_DIR)
Structured content is extracted from paper.md following the unified extraction schema (factual + evaluative in a single pass)
card.md is generated using the quick card template
card-deep.md is generated using the deep card template
Both files contain YAML frontmatter with title, authors, year, venue
The cards include extracted sections like problem, method, results, limitations

evals.prompt: 帮我深度分析一下 Attention Is All You Need 这篇论文，做个结构化拆解
evals.expected_output: Delegate to paper-import first, then generate card-deep.md.
expectations: The skill detects input as a paper reference (title), not a folder_slug
paper-import is called to resolve identity and acquire the paper
card-deep.md is generated with novelty assessment and star ratings
The output references specific sections and page numbers from the paper

evals.prompt: 帮我总结一下 ~/docs/papers/xxx/ 这篇论文
evals.expected_output: Generate card.md as a quick summary card.
expectations: The skill checks for metadata.yaml and paper/paper.md prerequisites
If prerequisites are missing and input is a folder_slug, inform the user
If prerequisites exist, card.md is generated with problem, method, key results
The card includes a one-paragraph executive summary at the top

evals.expected_output: Convert local PDF to markdown, resolve identity, then generate card.
expectations: The skill detects input as a local PDF file path
pdf-to-md is called to convert the PDF to markdown
paper-search is called to resolve paper identity (arXiv ID from filename)
PDF and markdown are copied to $PAPERS_DIR/{folder_slug}/paper/
card.md is generated from the converted content

evals.prompt: 帮我给 Geom-GCN 做个卡片，用中文写
evals.expected_output: Delegate to paper-import, then generate Chinese card.
expectations: The skill detects input as a paper reference and delegates to paper-import
Card output language is Chinese (matching user's language request)
Section headers are in Chinese (## 问题, ## 方法, ## 结果, etc.)
Frontmatter title, authors, venue remain in original English
Technical terms (Geom-GCN, GCN, ICLR) remain in English

evals.prompt: Give me a deep analysis of the GAT paper in English
evals.expected_output: Delegate to paper-import, then generate English card.
expectations: Card output language is English (matching user's language)
Section headers are in English (## Problem, ## Method, ## Results, etc.)
All analysis content is in English
